notes: Best $/tok for big dense models and the best all-around pick for a plug-in box that runs 70B at a usable speed and shuts up. ~12.6 tok/s on Llama-3.3-70B 4-bit (record comm-apple-m1-ultra-llama33-70b-4bit-decode) with headroom for 100B+ MoEs. ~800 GB/s unified memory; whole capacity usable by GPU, no VRAM ceiling. Idles ~15-20 W, ~90-150 W under inference, whisper-quiet - lowest dB and W of any path in this slice. Downside: RAM is soldered forever, used pricing is DRAM-inflated. M1 Ultra 64GB $1,600-2,100; M2 Ultra 192GB $3,200-4,200 (capacity play, ~9-11 t/s 70B, runs Qwen3-235B-A22B 26.4 t/s on MLX).
